rules:
THREE SEEDS FOR EVERY TRAINED BACKBONE (paper 2). Decided by the authors 2026-09-29 ~13:50 UTC so that
every backbone carries the same evidence as the primary backbone (Qwen3.5-4B: seeds 42/43/44).
Written before any stage below is built or run, and before any Pixtral-12B seed-43 TEST cell exists
(at the last pack, 2026-09-29 13:37 UTC, Pixtral seed 43 had finished only v3 training, the dev-set
descriptive eval and was training the mixed-unit adapter).

KNOWN PRIOR OUTCOMES (recorded, not hidden):
  seed 42 (verdicts in results/courtdyn/{backbone2_r2,backbone3_internvl,backbone4_a100}/verdict.json):
    Qwen2.5-VL-3B R1 intermediate, R2-E intermediate, R2-T intermediate, R3 replicates, R4 LIMITED;
    InternVL3-2B  R1 intermediate, R2-E LIMITED, R2-T replicates, R3 fails, R4 replicates;
    SmolVLM2-2.2B degenerate at the 4-epoch cap (descriptive only);
    Pixtral-12B   R1 replicates, R2-E intermediate, R2-T LIMITED, R3 replicates, R4 LIMITED;
    Idefics3-8B   R1 LIMITED, R2-E intermediate, R2-T intermediate, R3 intermediate, R4 LIMITED;
    Gemma3-12B    R1 fails, R2-E LIMITED, R2-T intermediate, R3 fails, R4 replicates.
  seed 43 (results/courtdyn/backbone4_ext/verdict.json): Gemma3-12B R1 intermediate ("not confirmed
    at seed 43"), R2-E LIMITED, R2-T intermediate, R3 fails, R4 replicates. Pixtral-12B seed 43: no
    test result seen.

NEW RUNS (the last seeds for this paper; none are added afterwards whatever the outcome):
  local RTX 5060 8 GB (the machine of their seed-42 runs): Qwen2.5-VL-3B, InternVL3-2B, SmolVLM2-2.2B,
    seeds 43 and 44.
  A100-40GB (the machine of their seed-42 runs): Idefics3-8B seeds 43 and 44; Pixtral-12B and
    Gemma3-12B seed 44 (their seed 43 is the running extension, results/courtdyn/backbone4_ext).
  Each backbone stays on the machine of its seed-42 run, so seed is not confounded with hardware.
  RTC is NOT part of this record.

PROTOCOL, per backbone and seed, exactly as the extension record (backbone4_ext, rules_sha256
171b9dc9fb63bd855f75052311dd8ada73f648bb6b006cc43cf987b3e886d0ca, group 1): the backbone's own
round-2-protocol record applies verbatim (backbone2_r2 for Qwen2.5-VL-3B and SmolVLM2-2.2B,
backbone3_internvl for InternVL3-2B, backbone4_a100 for Idefics3-8B, Pixtral-12B, Gemma3-12B) with
--seed changed for BOTH the metre-only (v3) and mixed-unit adapters; same pools, recipe, image policy,
pinned revisions, nf4 evaluation, test cells, 392-item text probe; unadapted-backbone cells and base
probe REUSED from seed 42. SCHEDULE FIXED to the seed-42 selection (the dev stopping rule is NOT
re-run): Qwen2.5-VL-3B k = 4, InternVL3-2B k = 2, Idefics3-8B k = 2, Pixtral-12B k = 2, Gemma3-12B
k = 2, SmolVLM2-2.2B k = 4 (degenerate at the cap at seed 42; its cells stay descriptive at every seed,
and any seed at which its metre-only adapter gives >= 5 distinct dev answers per family is reported as
such, descriptively). The step-k v3 adapter's dev answers are recorded descriptively only. R1-R4 and
the degeneracy readings are those of round 2 (R2 amended: R >= 10 AND rho_cm >= 0.30), applied to each
seed alone.

AGGREGATION OVER SEEDS 42/43/44, per backbone and per rule (never pooling cells across seeds):
  "holds at all three seeds"      the rule replicates at 3 of 3 seeds;
  "holds at two of three seeds"   replicates at 2 and fails at none;
  "fails across seeds"            fails at >= 2 seeds and replicates at none;
  "seed-dependent"                replicates at >= 1 seed and fails at >= 1 seed;
  "not established"               anything else (intermediate / LIMITED at >= 2 seeds).
  The paper states a rule as holding for a backbone only under the first two labels, and reports the
  per-seed verdicts in a table for every backbone.

TITLE (supersedes tools/decide_paper2_title.py as committed in 197b7f7/f0ffb70, which read Pixtral seed
43 alone; superseded before any Pixtral seed-43 test cell exists): the unhedged title is never restored;
the plural title ("... Can Make Vision--Language Models ...") is kept iff Pixtral-12B R1 is "holds at
all three seeds" or "holds at two of three seeds"; otherwise the singular title ("... Can Make a
Vision--Language Model ..."). Decided only when all three Pixtral seeds are judged.
GEMMA WORDING: Gemma3-12B's R1 aggregate label, verbatim, decides how the counterexample is described.
note: Local record, not externally timestamped. Seeds chosen after seeing the seed-42 outcomes and Gemma seed 43 listed above.
